answer: An exchange for lotus plants, violet dye and velvet can assign influence by audited upload capacity. In one synchronized round, independent auditors send each key distinct random blocks and require their timely return. Count only delivered bytes, with no account bonus. Splitting a link among a thousand agents divides its measured throughput; extra influence needs extra bandwidth. Auditors cross-check logs and reject reused blocks. Colluding auditors and rented links remain risks.
